about: Labelled exchanges for the memory gate prompt (MemoryGate). The gate sees only the user's message; the reply is here to show that facts in it must never count. label is what a good gate answers; quote, for labels other than none, is a span a good gate may copy (any verbatim span that carries the fact passes).
